description: Fleet session-management Phase B, D1 (§4). Returns every live managed_session ledger row, optionally filtered by lane_id, work_class, host, or lifecycle_state (equality filters only, combined with AND). This is the ONE fleet list — operator-launched sessions carry a row too (written at normal registration, not through spawn_session), so this verb never needs a separate 'manual sessions' query.
embedding_description: Browse or search the current fleet roster — which sessions exist right now, grouped or filtered by lane, work class, host, or lifecycle state. A read-only survey query, never a spawn and never a single-row lookup.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: sessions: an array of managed_session ledger rows matching the supplied filters (empty array if none match; never an error for a legitimate zero-result query).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the count and group by lifecycle_state or lane when useful. Do not claim host liveness beyond what the row's lifecycle_state says — this verb reads the ledger, not a live host probe.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: A pure filtered read over the managed_session table via StateManagementInterface; no state mutation, no host interaction.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound on this homunculus.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: state_service_unavailable indicates a platform binding problem, not a caller error — report it rather than retrying with different filters.
